## What your week looks like on Roooster.

Three everyday workflows, from first photo to money in the bank.

Quoting from the driveway

Snap a photo, review the AI draft, and send a polished Good, Better, or Best quote in about a minute, often before you're back at the truck.

A crew that actually uses the app

Techs get a simple day view with their jobs in order: check in, add photos, mark complete. No training manual required.

Invoices that close themselves

When a job is marked complete, the invoice is ready from the accepted quote. Customers pay by card or text link, and payouts typically arrive in about 2 business days through Stripe.

Illustrative workflows showing how Roooster is designed to work, not customer reviews.

## Common questions.

What is Roooster?

Roooster is AI-native field service management software built for home service businesses: pressure washing, window cleaning, HVAC, lawn care, and more. It combines AI-powered quoting, scheduling, dispatch, invoicing, and payments in one platform so you can run your entire business from a single screen.

How does the AI quoting work?

Upload a photo or enter an address. Roooster's vision AI analyzes the property, measuring surface area, surface types, and access complexity, then drafts an itemized Good/Better/Best quote in about 30 seconds for you to review. No measuring tape, no spreadsheet, no guessing.

Does Roooster work for solo operators?

Yes. The Solo plan is built for owner-operators running without a team. You can quote, book, invoice, and get paid without adding a single team member. When you're ready to grow, adding techs and crews takes about two minutes.

How much does Roooster cost?

Roooster has simple monthly plans for solo operators, small crews, and larger operations. See current pricing on the plans page. Every plan starts with a 

Try Roooster free.

Can customers book online without calling me?

Yes. Roooster generates a public booking link for your business. Customers pick a service, choose a date, enter their address, and pay a deposit, all without calling or texting you. The booking widget also embeds on your website.

Is Roooster available on mobile?

Roooster is a web app that works on any browser including mobile Safari and Chrome. Field technicians use the /me/today view, a PWA that works offline for check-ins, job notes, and photo uploads even without a signal.
